Theorem
[Existence of singularity models with bounded curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0061, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0062 ↗ thm:chow-iv-no-local-collapsing ↗ def:chow-iv-finite-time-singularity-model 1. ch28:28.8\group Singularity Models

For a finite-time singular flow on a closed manifold there are $(x_i,t_i)$, $t_i\to T$, with $K_i=|\Rm |(x_i,t_i)\to \infty $, such that $K_i g(t_i+K_i^{-1}t)$ converges to a nonflat complete ancient solution with uniformly bounded sectional curvature.
